newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index down in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index down in thin trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Thursday closed slightly down by 0.11 percent in thin trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 495.62 from 496.16 on Wednesday.
Total volume was 753,355 dinars against 2.48 million dinars.
Cola and beer bottler SFBT fell 0.8 dinar to 90.2 dinars. BIAT bank which held its annual general meeting on Wednesday, was down 0.9 dinar to 36 dinars. BDET bank declined 0.54 dinar to 17.42.
STB bank slid 0.56 dinar to 18.06. Airline Tunis Air eased 0.32 dinar to 23.16 dinars. UBCI bank dropped 0.42 dinar to 48.6. BTEI bank edged lower 0.16 dinar to 22.8.
Retail stores Monoprix MONO.TN was up 0.52 dinar to 36.22 dinars. Detergent firm SPCD rose 0.2 dinar to 36.8. ($1=1.08 dinar)
